items.title: Gemini 4 Carbon
items.title_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Carbon：一个暂时用不上的前沿模型
items.title_en: Google Announces Gemini 4 Carbon, a Frontier Model You Can't Use Yet
items.summary: Google announces Gemini 4 Carbon, sparking intense community discussion about model naming confusion and the value of benchmarks without an immediate release.

items.title: 🍎 Apple 新款 MacBook Pro 首发  PROLED XDR 显示屏并加入触控
items.title_zh: Apple 发布搭载 PROLED XDR 屏并首次支持触控的 MacBook Pro
items.title_en: Apple unveils MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR OLED and first Mac touchscreen
items.summary: Apple unveiled a redesigned MacBook Pro featuring a PROLED XDR tandem OLED display, first-ever Mac touch support, M5 Pro/M5 Max chips, thinner chassis, and up to 24-hour battery life.

items.title: Why is this fingerprinting script creating bioweapons?
items.title_zh: 为什么一段JS指纹脚本会被大模型判定为“生物武器”
items.title_en: Why a JS Fingerprinting Script Triggers 'Bioweapon' LLM Refusals
items.summary: A security researcher investigates why a benign JS fingerprinting script gets flagged as bioweapon-related by LLM safety filters, uncovering a fractal arms race of anti-LLM prompt 'incantations', obfuscation honey pots, and model fingerprinting.

items.title: Apple's git still trusts the compromised eMudhra certificates
items.title_zh: macOS 的 git 等系统工具仍在信任被攻破的 eMudhra CA 证书
items.title_en: macOS git and other system tools still trust compromised eMudhra CA certificates
items.summary: Apple's macOS git and other system utilities continue to trust compromised eMudhra certificates, requiring manual mitigation that OS updates may undo.

items.title: [R] Taking EmbeddingGemma-2 (577M) from Rank #26 to #1 on the MAEB audio benchmark by filling its 256d null space with PCA-reduced intermediate Conformer layers (zero training) [R]
items.title_zh: 零训练 PCA 零空间注入让 EmbeddingGemma-2 在 MAEB 音频基准上从第 26 名跃升至第 1 名
items.title_en: Zero-training PCA null-space injection lifts EmbeddingGemma-2 from Rank #26 to #1 on MAEB audio benchmark
items.summary: A training-free PCA-based null-space injection of intermediate Conformer layers lifts EmbeddingGemma-2 from Rank #26 to #1 on the MAEB audio benchmark.

items.title: 🤖 谷歌发布 Gemini 4 Argon，物理推理得分 87%  谷歌发布新一代多模态推理模型 Gemini 4 Argon，强化物理理解、代码生成与视觉语义
items.title_zh: 谷歌据称发布 Gemini 4 Argon 多模态推理模型
items.title_en: Google Reportedly Releases Gemini 4 Argon Multimodal Reasoning Model
items.summary: Google reportedly released Gemini 4 Argon, a multimodal reasoning model claiming 87% on the ERQA embodied-reasoning benchmark and improved robotic task performance.
